forbidden: particle trail is an observed track

od.question: How much movement connects two places, in which direction?
forbidden: schematic arc is a traveled route

release.question: Where might particles advect in this fixed vector field?

invariants.fieldVectorConvention: u east-positive, v north-positive, meteorological direction is FROM clockwise from north
invariants.baseMapProjection: Plate Carree only if nominal 2:1 aspect is preserved; show viewport stretch separately
invariants.unitTime: simulated_seconds = min(real_elapsed_ms,100ms)/1000 * dimensionless_rate; bounded per foreground frame after tab suspension
invariants.outsideField: do not silently extrapolate outside source spatial coverage
invariants.geographicSeam: never connect an antimeridian discontinuity or particle respawn with a drawn trajectory
invariants.selectedState: only one authoritative controller for mode, play, time, and URL selection state
invariants.urlIsolation: preserve non-Flow search parameters while replacing only validated flow-prefixed keys
invariants.reducedMotion: respect system preference and offer persistent pause
invariants.cleanup: listeners, intervals, animation frames and observers are removed on unmount
invariants.fieldLineage: field sampled as instantaneous model snapshot; fixed-step RK2 path is a frozen-field experiment, not an actual tracked object
invariants.noExtrapolation: regular or GFS samples outside latitude coverage return {valid:false} rather than clamping
invariants.onePlaybackController: base flow-lab.js owns mode, pause, tripPlay, tripTime and all simulation progression; Round2 never installs a second interval
invariants.projection: Plate Carree fits a true 2:1 world pixel rectangle at all viewport sizes; inverse coordinates reject letterboxed margins
invariants.flowSelection: OD place and TRIPS teaching track selection support keyboard-accessible native selects in WORK, INSPECT and FOCUS
invariants.pinnedSample: Touch or keyboard sample yields a visible map-footer readout in every workspace mode
invariants.releaseIntegrator: Euler/RK2/RK4 steps use one sampled frozen field and check all intermediate points for domain validity
invariants.releaseClock: elapsed release time advances only with active seeds, and resets when the experiment is cleared
invariants.releaseUncertainty: spherical-cap seed spread represents chosen initial conditions only; it is not quantified forecast uncertainty
invariants.windColor: speed color is a fixed 0–30+ metres/second quantitative scale; model color has no observational or uncertainty meaning
invariants.canonicalMovementData: one site/flow/v3/core/movement.mjs source defines directed OD weights, nodes and authored teaching TRIPS points for both renderers
invariants.odDirection: A to B and B to A remain distinct directed normalized teaching weights; net outflow equals out minus in
invariants.odFiltering: Top-N filters visible directed edges without mutating all-network totals
invariants.tripInterpolation: hollow markers encode supplied teaching sample positions; derived great-circle display positions are not observations
invariants.tripTime: authored relative teaching units only, never UTC or measured hours; one base timeline and global PAUSE govern WORK, FOCUS and INSPECT
invariants.tripDistance: computed spherical great-circle arc lengths between supplied teaching samples in km, not a measured track or km/h
invariants.sourceCache: Live Open-Meteo no-store; pinned Natural Earth/GFS force-cache; source metadata records UTC valid and retrieval times separately
invariants.sourceRecovery: Invalid coordinate/time/unit grid rejects live data; GFS archived fallback then explicit synthetic field with labeled source failures
invariants.performanceEvidence: Bounded JS draw p95 measurements and CDP forced-GC heap evidence; viewport emulation is not physical mobile GPU validation
invariants.lifecycle: Base cancels its RAF/ResizeObserver and removes visibility listener; Round2 disconnects observers, cancels pointer RAF and deferred timers

uiTargets.mapReadability: all mode-critical controls are outside map content in WORK and INSPECT
uiTargets.focusMode: map-focused layout remains interactive; controls are accessible without blocking geography
uiTargets.mobile: no overlapping controls and map; touch inspection has a persistent result
